dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Mr. Brahe Reed Miller has quietly escorted the children who were still alive out of the facility."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "He said he knows an eccentric old hunter, and that he is also an old acquaintance of the newly appointed priestess of the Frostmoon Scions. I believe the title was something like 'Moonchanter.' Both are willing to protect those children. Neither has asked for anything in return."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Morozov never noticed a thing. He probably stopped caring about them a long time ago."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "There's nothing left to worry about. So before we go to meet him, let's share one last drink, as we always do."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "A toast to the dead, from those soon to die. Please forgive my foolishness all these years."
